policy: A release credit is shown only when the official release notes identify the contribution or explicitly credit the GitHub account, and the related pull request is merged.

items.title: Amp CLI signature
items.summary: Added Amp CLI and Amp Code Review GitHub Actions detection. The official v0.1.4 release notes explicitly thank @faizansaiyed123 for the Amp contribution.
items.verification: Official release notes name @faizansaiyed123 in the Amp contributor credit; corresponding PR #31 is in the verified merged external contribution set.

items.title: Cloudflare Workers KV instrumentation
items.summary: Added tracing instrumentation for Cloudflare Workers KV bindings to the JavaScript SDK.
items.verification: Official v11.10.0 release notes link the Workers KV change to PR #25488; the PR is in the verified merged external contribution set.

items.title: LoaderSentry type export
items.summary: Exported the LoaderSentry type from the browser SDK.
items.verification: Official v11.9.0 release notes link the LoaderSentry type export to PR #25357; the PR is in the verified merged external contribution set.

items.title: Move FastAPI active thread tracking into Starlette
items.summary: Moved active-thread tracking from the FastAPI-specific integration to Starlette.
items.verification: Official v2.72.0 release notes identify @faizansaiyed123 and link PR #7825; the PR is in the verified merged external contribution set.

items.title: Fix light color-temperature gradient in RTL
items.summary: Corrected the light color-temperature gradient for right-to-left layouts.
items.verification: The official 20260930.0 prerelease notes include this exact change and credit @faizansaiyed123 with a link to PR #54468; the PR is merged. The release is explicitly a prerelease, not a stable release.
